input.quote: (a) Ono shall, and shall require its Affiliates to, permit Array, and/or an authorized representative reasonably acceptable to Ono, to enter the relevant facilities of Ono and its Affiliates during normal business hours and upon reasonable advance notice to inspect and verify compliance with applicable regulatory and other requirements, as well as with this Agreement, with respect to all matters relating to the Product, all Ono Know-How to be provided to Array pursuant to Section 4.7 and the activities generating such Ono Know-How.
input.rationale: There are two audit-type rights binding us. The royalty audit in Section 7.4 (p0481-p0482) sits at or above the fallback: it is limited to once each Calendar Year (and one inspection per quarter), must be conducted by an independent nationally recognised accounting firm reasonably acceptable to us and bound by confidentiality, at reasonable times on reasonable prior written notice, at Array's expense unless an underpayment exceeding the (redacted) threshold is established, with no access to our systems - so we do not redline it (the un-quantified notice period and redacted underpayment percentage are noted only). Section 4.9(a), however, is a separate inspection right that fails the fallback on material terms: Array (not an independent auditor) may enter our facilities and examine our internal procedures and records to verify compliance "with this Agreement" with no frequency cap at all, no fixed notice period ("reasonable advance notice") and no cost allocation, and we must provide affirmative assistance. Unlimited audits are walk-away territory under this rule, so we propose the minimal insertion of a once-per-twelve-months cap, thirty (30) days' prior written notice and Array's cost, mirroring the mechanics already agreed in Section 7.4.

proposal.summary: Cap Array's Section 4.9(a) facility inspection right at once per 12 months, on 30 days' prior written notice, at Array's cost
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 4.9(a) lets Array enter our facilities and examine our records to verify compliance with the Agreement without any frequency limit, fixed notice period or cost allocation. We have added our standard limits - once in any twelve (12) month period, thirty (30) days' prior written notice and Array's cost - consistent with the royalty audit mechanics already agreed in Section 7.4; we can accept fifteen (15) days' notice if Array prefers.

ops.oldText: during normal business hours and upon reasonable advance notice to inspect and verify compliance
ops.newText: during normal business hours, no more than once in any twelve (12) month period and upon at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice, and at Array's cost, to inspect and verify compliance
